# agy


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

Find, read, search, and compact Antigravity CLI and desktop
conversations stored on this machine.

## Conversation layout

Antigravity CLI stores each conversation as a SQLite database under
`AGY_HOME/conversations/<id>.db`, alongside a summary index at
`AGY_HOME/conversation_summaries.db` and JSONL transcript mirrors under
`AGY_HOME/brain/<id>/.system_generated/logs/`. Desktop conversations use
the same schema under `AGY_APP_HOME` (`~/.gemini/antigravity`). Passing
`agy_home=None` searches both directories. Use
[`cur_conv`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#cur_conv)
for a running session’s id,
[`conv_file`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#conv_file)
to locate a database by id or unique prefix,
[`project_conv`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#project_conv)
for the newest conversation in a project,
[`resolve_conv`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#resolve_conv)
to accept an id, prefix, or title, and
[`prompt_hist`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#prompt_hist)
to recover earlier user prompts.

The `steps` table stores ordered protobuf records: user inputs (`14`),
planner responses (`15`), tool results (`132`), system messages (`101`),
and compaction checkpoints (`23`).
[`load_steps`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#load_steps)
decodes every step in the database.
[`active_steps`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#active_steps)
starts from the latest checkpoint.
[`steps2chat`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#steps2chat)
converts steps into canonical messages, unwrapping `call_mcp_tool` calls
and preserving untruncated `𝍁…𝍁` outputs.

## Reading workflow

Start with
[`conv2dlg`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#conv2dlg)
to read a conversation as an aidialog dialog. Search with
`d.find_msgs(pat)` and read messages with `view_msg`. For step-level
inspection, load with
[`load_conv`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#load_conv),
search with
[`step_search`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#step_search),
and display slices with
[`show_steps`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#show_steps).

Reading functions open SQLite read-only and never modify databases.
Synthetic compaction appends one `CHECKPOINT` row (`step_type = 23`)
directly to `steps`. Close Antigravity before running
[`append_compaction`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#append_compaction)
or
[`compact_session`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#compact_session).

``` python
from collections import Counter
from fastcore.test import *
import shutil, tempfile
```

## Protobuf wire helpers

Antigravity stores step payloads and metadata as standard unencrypted
protobuf messages. These wire helpers decode and encode varints and
length-delimited fields without adding a protobuf runtime dependency.

Check round-trip encoding for integers, strings, and timestamps:

``` python
ts_dt = datetime(2026, 11, 20, 2, 56, 12, 469000, timezone.utc)
wire = _pb_f_int(1, 23) + _pb_f_bytes(5, 'summary') + _pb_f_bytes(8, _pb_ts_bytes(ts_dt))
dec = _pb_decode(wire)
test_eq(_pb_one(dec, 1), 23)
test_eq(_pb_str(dec, 5), 'summary')
test_eq(_pb_ts(_pb_one(dec, 8)), '2026-11-20T02:56:12.469Z')
dec
```

## Where conversations live

Antigravity CLI stores databases in `AGY_HOME/conversations` and indexes
them in `AGY_HOME/conversation_summaries.db`. Commands started inside
Antigravity inherit `ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID`.
[`conv_file`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#conv_file)
looks up `<id>.db` directly first, then checks
`conversation_summaries.db` so desktop conversations under sibling app
data directories resolve by id too.

## Building synthetic conversations

These test helpers construct valid SQLite conversation databases with
real protobuf wire records matching Antigravity’s table and field
numbers. Keeping fixtures synthetic lets every notebook example run fast
without checking binary databases into git.

Create a temporary Antigravity home with one conversation that uses the
persistent kernel (including a `𝍁…𝍁` full-string output), `run_command`,
`read_file` on a `SKILL.md`, a hook system message, and an agent report:

``` python
home = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
proj = home/'project'
proj.mkdir()
cid, tid = 'ab12cd34-0000-4000-8000-000000000000', '11111111-0000-4000-8000-000000000000'
t0 = datetime(2026, 11, 20, 2, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
t1 = datetime(2026, 11, 20, 2, 1, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
t2 = datetime(2026, 11, 20, 2, 2, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

mcp_args = dict(ServerName='aai-coding_clikernel', ToolName='exec', Arguments=dict(code='6 * 7'))
sample_rows = [_mk_user(0, 'Check the flux meter skill and compute 6*7.', tid, cid, ts=t0),
    _mk_sys(1, 'The following system message was injected by a SessionStart hook:\nnbdev project.', 'hook_json_SessionStart', tid, cid, ts=t0),
    _mk_asst(2, 'Reading the skill and running the kernel.', tid, cid, thinking='Private thought.',
        calls=[('c1', 'read_file', dict(Path='/skills/flux/SKILL.md')),
            ('c2', 'call_mcp_tool', mcp_args),
            ('c3', 'run_command', dict(CommandLine='printf "flux: 41.7\\n"'))], ts=t0),
    _mk_tool(3, 'c1', 'read_file', dict(Path='/skills/flux/SKILL.md'),
        'Created At: 2026-11-20T12:00:00+10:00\nCompleted At: 2026-11-20T12:00:01+10:00\nShowing lines 1-2 of 2\n1: # Flux skill', tid, cid, ts=t0),
    _mk_tool(4, 'c2', 'call_mcp_tool', mcp_args,
        'A pre-tool hook changed the arguments of this tool call before it ran.\n\nCreated At: 2026-11-20T12:00:01+10:00\nCompleted At: 2026-11-20T12:00:02+10:00\n𝍁42𝍁',
        tid, cid, mcp_raw='𝍁42𝍁', ts=t0),
    _mk_tool(5, 'c3', 'run_command', dict(CommandLine='printf "flux: 41.7\\n"'),
        'Created At: 2026-11-20T12:00:02+10:00\nCompleted At: 2026-11-20T12:00:03+10:00\nCommand exited with code 0.\n\nCommand output:\nflux: 41.7', tid, cid, ts=t0),
    _mk_asst(6, 'The kernel returned 42 and the flux reading is 41.7.', tid, cid, ts=t1),
    _mk_sys(7, '[Message] timestamp=2026-11-20T02:02:00Z sender=e6572eae priority=MESSAGE_PRIORITY_HIGH content=Subagent verified flux units.', 'agent_message', tid, cid, ts=t2)]
db_path = _init_conv_db(home/'conversations'/f'{cid}.db', cid, tid, proj, sample_rows, title='Flux Check', agy_home=home)
```

Resolve the conversation by id prefix, path, project directory, or
title;
[`project_conv`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#project_conv)
skips child conversations (summarized or not), ignores empty `-wal`
files, and reads closed databases without creating `-wal` files:

``` python
test_eq(conv_file('ab12cd34', home), db_path)
test_eq(project_conv(proj, home), (cid, db_path))
test_eq(resolve_conv('Flux Check', proj, home), (cid, db_path))
test_eq(conv_file(db_path), db_path)
w1_cid, w2_cid = 'cd34ef56-1111-4000-8000-000000000000', 'ef56ab78-2222-4000-8000-000000000000'
w1 = _init_conv_db(home/'conversations'/f'{w1_cid}.db', w1_cid, tid, proj, [], agy_home=home, parent=cid)
w2 = _init_conv_db(home/'conversations'/f'{w2_cid}.db', w2_cid, tid, proj, [], parent=cid)
con = sqlite3.connect(w2)
con.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL')
con.close()
os.utime(w1, ns=(db_path.stat().st_atime_ns, db_path.stat().st_mtime_ns + 2_000_000_000))
wal0 = Path(f'{db_path}-wal')
wal0.write_bytes(b'')
os.utime(wal0, ns=(db_path.stat().st_atime_ns, db_path.stat().st_mtime_ns + 3_000_000_000))
test_eq(db_mtime_ns(db_path), db_path.stat().st_mtime_ns)
test_eq(project_conv(proj, home), (cid, db_path))
assert not Path(f'{w2}-wal').exists()
wal0.unlink()
resolve_conv('ab12cd34', proj, home)
```

## Reading and searching a conversation

[`load_steps`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#load_steps)
decodes every row in `steps` into a uniform `AttrDict`. For
`call_mcp_tool` calls,
[`_norm_call`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#_norm_call)
unwraps `ServerName`, `ToolName`, and `Arguments` into
`mcp__<server>__<tool>` so downstream compaction and dialog tools treat
persistent-kernel calls like those from Claude Code and Codex. For MCP
results,
[`_tool_result_text`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#_tool_result_text)
reads the raw `McpTool` payload (or an offloaded `output.txt` when it
carries `𝍁…𝍁` markers) so Antigravity’s hook and timestamp prefixes
never hide untruncated `FullString` outputs.

test_eq(Counter(steps.attrgot('role')), Counter(user=1, system=2, assistant=2, tool=3))

test_eq((steps[4].tool_name, steps[4].text, steps[4].full), ('mcp__aai-coding_clikernel__exec', '𝍁42𝍁', True))
[(s.idx, s.role, s.get('tool_name', s.get('tag', ''))) for s in steps]

## Active history and dialogs

[`split_compaction`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#split_compaction)
locates the latest `CHECKPOINT` step (`step_type = 23`). For an
`llmsurgery` synthetic checkpoint (whose text contains
`\n\n## Conversation\n\n`), it extracts the unchanged DSL body with
[`compact_body`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/compact.html#compact_body).
For a native `/compact` checkpoint, it keeps the native summary text.
[`active_steps`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#active_steps)
returns steps from that latest checkpoint onward.

[`steps2chat`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#steps2chat)
converts decoded steps into canonical `Msg` objects with `created` and
`uid` metadata. It drops hook plumbing (`hook_json_*`), fork notices,
and `sender=system` restart notices. With `agent_results=True`, it
retains `agent_message`, `task_notification`, `plan_mode_handoff`, and
untagged `[Message]` steps so compaction preserves subagent reports
under their bounded budget.

``` python
dlg = conv2dlg('ab12cd34', proj, home)

```

Subagent conversations start with an `agent_message` system step instead
of a `USER_INPUT` step.
[`steps2chat`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#steps2chat)
turns that opening message into the dialog’s first user prompt:

``` python
def _row2step(r): return _parse_step(r[0], r[1], r[2], r[4], r[5], r[9])
sub_msgs = steps2chat([
    _row2step(_mk_sys(0, '[Message] timestamp=2026-11-20T02:00:00Z sender=parent priority=MESSAGE_PRIORITY_HIGH content=Check the tests.', 'agent_message', tid, cid, ts=t0)),
    _row2step(_mk_asst(1, 'All tests pass.', tid, cid, ts=t1))])
test_eq([m.role for m in sub_msgs], ['user', 'assistant'])
test_eq(sub_msgs[0].content[0].text, 'Check the tests.')
sub_msgs[0].content[0].text
```

## Synthetic compaction

Antigravity compacts a conversation by appending one `CHECKPOINT` row
(`step_type = 23`, `status = 3`) to `steps` without rewriting prior rows
or `gen_metadata`. When resumed, Antigravity builds `<CONTEXT_SUMMARY>`
from payload field `30 -> 5`, stops before the cutoff index in
`30 -> 12`, and uses `30 -> 29` as the rendered summary message’s
identifier.

[`transcript_path`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#transcript_path)
points the continuation document to
`brain/<id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl` when present,
falling back to the `.db` path.

### prepare_compaction

``` python
def prepare_compaction(
    ref:NoneType=None, # Conversation id, prefix, or title; current or project's newest if None
    cwd:str='.', # Project directory
    agy_home:NoneType=None, # Antigravity app data directory, list of directories, or None for CLI and desktop
    policy:dict={'user_toks': 2000, 'asst_toks': 150, 'call_toks': 60, 'result_toks': 35}, # Token budget dictionary for `compact_chat`
    enc:NoneType=None, # Tokenizer encoding; `compact_enc()` if None
):
```

*Prepare an incremental synthetic compaction without writing to SQLite*

Prepare a compaction first and inspect it before writing. The
`clikernel` call renders as fenced Python, `𝍁42𝍁` stays marked
untruncated, `run_command` renders with `!`, the agent message uses
`> Agent:`, and the footer reminds the resumed session to re-read
`/skills/flux/SKILL.md`:

``` python
before_n = len(load_steps(db_path))
comp = prepare_compaction('ab12cd34', proj, home)
test_eq(len(load_steps(db_path)), before_n)
test('```python\n6 * 7\n```', comp.chat, in_)
test('𝍁> 42𝍁', comp.chat, in_)
test('! printf "flux: 41.7\\n"', comp.chat, in_)
test('> Agent: Subagent verified flux units.', comp.chat, in_)
test('re-read: /skills/flux/SKILL.md', comp.content, in_)
comp.pre_toks, comp.post_toks, comp.step.idx
```

Append the checkpoint and confirm it becomes the latest step in the
database:

``` python
append_compaction(comp)
after = load_steps(db_path)
test_eq(len(after), before_n + 1)
test_eq(after[-1].step_type, STEP_CHECKPOINT)
test_eq(split_compaction(after), (comp.chat, L()))
test_eq(_summary_rows(home)[0].cid, cid)
after[-1].step_type, after[-1].idx
```

Append a second exchange and compact again with
[`compact_session`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#compact_session).
The new checkpoint keeps the earlier DSL body unchanged and appends only
the new turns:

``` python
more = [_mk_user(9, 'Now verify the units.', tid, cid, ts=t2),
    _mk_asst(10, 'Units confirmed: kilofinches.', tid, cid, ts=t2)]
with sqlite3.connect(db_path) as con: con.executemany('INSERT INTO steps VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)', more)
comp2 = compact_session(cid, proj, home)
test_eq(comp2.prior, comp.chat)
test('Now verify the units.', comp2.new_chat, in_)
test('Units confirmed: kilofinches.', comp2.chat, in_)
test_eq(load_steps(db_path)[-1].idx, 11)
comp2.chat
```

A native Antigravity `/compact` checkpoint holds a
`<summary>...</summary>` block instead of `## Conversation`. Subsequent
[`compact_session`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html#compact_session)
calls keep that native summary verbatim and compact only the steps added
after it:

``` python
nat_cid = 'cd34ef56-0000-4000-8000-000000000000'
nat_ckpt = checkpoint_step(1, '<summary>\nNative summary of earlier work.\n</summary>', tid, nat_cid)
nat_rows = [_mk_user(0, 'Old turn before native compact.', tid, nat_cid, ts=t0),
    (1, STEP_CHECKPOINT, STATUS_DONE, 0, nat_ckpt.metadata, None, None, None, None, nat_ckpt.step_payload, 0),
    _mk_user(2, 'Continue after native compact.', tid, nat_cid, ts=t1),
    _mk_asst(3, 'Continuing now.', tid, nat_cid, ts=t1)]
nat_db = _init_conv_db(home/'conversations'/f'{nat_cid}.db', nat_cid, tid, proj, nat_rows, agy_home=home)
nat_comp = prepare_compaction(nat_cid, proj, home)
test_eq(nat_comp.prior, '<summary>\nNative summary of earlier work.\n</summary>')
assert 'Old turn before native compact.' not in nat_comp.chat
test('Continue after native compact.', nat_comp.chat, in_)
nat_comp.chat
```

## Cleanup

Remove the temporary Antigravity home directory.

``` python
shutil.rmtree(home)
```
